Verified per-site (RFC 0106): `Digest::SHA1.hexdigest(secret).first(4)` (`encryption/key.rb:25`) — ActiveSupport's `String#first(n)`, a positional idiom whose JS spelling is `slice(0, n)`. `first`/`last`/`size` are positional/property idioms with no JS call form, deliberately left uncredited by RFC 0092 (`positional-idiom-analogues`, see JS_ENUMERABLE_ALIASES' header comment), so the reason-text route is the sanctioned one; nothing was dropped from the TS body. The digest divergence on the same line (SHA-256/8 chars where Rails takes SHA-1/4) is fixed here, closing `encryption-key-id-uses-sha256-not-sha1`.
